title: The Planet Formation Potential around a 45 Myr Old Accreting M Dwarf
question: Is the 45 Myr old accreting M dwarf W0808 hosting a gas-rich protoplanetary disk or a debris disk, and what is the origin of its cold dust?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 23 uJy/beam; line rms 1.8 mJy/beam/channel

what.value: Stellar parameters (Teff, RV, mass, age, spectral type, etc.)

evidence.quote: Stellar properties of W0808, drawn from (cite: mur18).
assuming an opacity of 2.3 g cm$^{-2}$ at 1.3mm (cite: bec90)

what.value: Dust masses vs age of M dwarf protoplanetary and debris disks for comparison

evidence.quote: Figure [3](#mass_age) shows dust mass, as derived from sub-mm emission, as a function of age for protoplanetary disks

external_data.citation: (cite: ric12; ric14; van16; liu04; mat15; hol17 etc.)

evidence.quote: we utilize the photodissociation rates of (cite: vis09)
we assume the ratio between the FUV and J-band flux densities is 4$\times$10$^{-5}$
along with template SEDs for extragalactic sources (cite: kir15)

what.value: Schechter function for background galaxy chance probability

evidence.quote: based on the Schechter function of (cite: car15)

recipe.goal: calibrate visibilities and shift phase center
recipe.method: Standard ALMA calibration script; phase center shifted to Gaia DR2 predicted stellar position
key_parameters: J0635-7516 gain and bandpass; J0904-5735 phase

recipe.method: CASA clean with natural weighting on all four spectral windows; point-source fit to visibilities for total flux
Optically thin dust mass M_d = F d^2 /(kappa B(T))
key_parameters: T_dust = 20 K; opacity 2.3 g cm^-2 at 1.3mm
assumptions: Optically thin emission; disk radius <16 au implied by unresolved emission at 101 pc; blackbody grains at 16 au have 20 K

recipe.goal: CO flux and mass upper limits
recipe.method: 3sigma flux limit assuming uniform ring to 16 au at 45 deg inclination (~1 beam, ~10 channels); LTE mass at 20 K
key_parameters: Tex = 20 K; also 1071 K and 237 K
assumptions: LTE; NLTE would likely raise the limit

recipe.method: Photodissociation rates of Visser et al. with stellar FUV plus Draine interstellar field, with and without self-shielding
key_parameters: FUV/J flux density ratio 4e-5; 5e-6 Mearth CO over 30 au diameter for self-shielding

recipe.goal: assess origin of dust: PR drag, collisions, background galaxy
recipe.method: Strubbe & Chiang prescriptions for wind drag; SED comparison with z=2 template; Schechter function chance-coincidence probability

answer_key.quantity: 1.3 mm continuum total flux (point source fit)

evidence.quote: a point source fit to the visibilities derives a total flux of 198$\pm$15 $\mu$Jy
The continuum emission is significantly detected with a peak flux of 194 $\mu$Jy/beam
We derive a dust mass of 0.057$\pm$0.006 M$_{\oplus}$
The emission is unresolved, which implies a disk radius $<$16 au at 101 pc.
we derive a 3$\sigma$ upper limit on the CO(2-1) flux of $<$10 mJy km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Cold CO gas mass upper limit (LTE, 20 K)

evidence.quote: upper limit on the cold CO gas mass of $<$5$\times10^{-6}$ M$_{\oplus}$

answer_key.quantity: CO photodissociation timescale close to star (<10 au), no self-shielding
CO photodissociation timescale with self-shielding, 10-20 au

evidence.quote: the photo-dissociation timescale increases to 150-350 years between 10 and 20 au

answer_key.quantity: Chance probability of background galaxy at 8sigma within 0.5"

evidence.quote: there is a 0.01% chance of detecting a background galaxy at 8$\sigma$ within 0$\ensuremath{''}$5 of the stellar position

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version used for calibration and imaging
Clean threshold, masking, cell size and image size
Spectral channel binning/velocity range used for line cubes
Exact model and software for the point source visibility fit
Details of the CO LTE mass calculation (molecular data, partition function)
Dust temperature/opacity details such as frequency scaling for kappa
Details of the photodissociation calculation (Draine field scaling, self-shielding setup)
Details of the stellar wind drag calculation parameters
score_reason: Simple dataset and recipe with numeric results, but imaging parameters and CASA version unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Single archival project, simple recipe, numeric flux and mass results.
